# Humaaans

Illustrations: **Humaaans** by Pablo Stanley — https://www.humaaans.com
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Colors in this project are remapped to the site palette; parts are recombined and animated.

The `body-parts` files were taken from the npm package `humaaans` (v1.7.0, MIT wrapper by jktzes),
which packages Pablo Stanley's artwork as React components.
